column1: =Damage multiplier increased to <color=#f26c1c>300%</color>; when attacking, ignores target's Defense increased to <color=#f26c1c>200%</color> and nullifies all percentage Defense bonus effects on the target; <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> effect enhanced, when taking Physical damage, takes an additional <color=#f26c1c>10%</color> of final damage as Fixed damage.

column1: # --- shield ---
=If this unit does not have a Shield, damage taken is increased by <color=#f26c1c>50%</color>.
column2: Jika unit ini tidak memiliki Shield, damage yang diterima meningkat sebesar <color=#f26c1c>50%</color>.

column1: =When attacking, units with shields deal additional fixed damage equal to (shield value) x <color=#f26c1c>50%</color>.
column2: Saat menyerang, unit yang memiliki shield memberikan tambahan fixed damage setara (nilai shield) x <color=#f26c1c>50%</color>.

column1: =When this unit has a shield, critical rate is increased by <color=#f26c1c>30%</color>.
column2: Saat unit ini memiliki shield, Critical Rate meningkat sebesar <color=#f26c1c>30%</color>.

column1: =When this unit has a shield, Freeze-type attacks reduce the cooldown for all skills by <color=#f26c1c>1 turn</color>.
column2: Saat unit ini memiliki shield, serangan tipe Freeze mengurangi cooldown semua skill sebesar <color=#f26c1c>1 giliran</color>.

column1: =When gaining shields, units recover <color=#f26c1c>1 point</color> of Confectance Index, HP equal to <color=#f26c1c>15%</color> of Max HP, and <color=#f26c1c>2 points</color> of stability.
column2: Saat mendapatkan shield, unit memulihkan <color=#f26c1c>1 poin</color> Confectance Index, HP setara <color=#f26c1c>15%</color> Max HP, dan <color=#f26c1c>2 poin</color> Stability.

column1: =When shield is broken, deal fixed damage to the attacker equal to <color=#f26c1c>50%</color> of the applier's defense.
column2: Saat shield pecah, memberikan fixed damage ke penyerangnya setara <color=#f26c1c>50%</color> Defense pemberi shield.

column1: =Phase damage dealt to enemy units with Shields is increased by <color=#f26c1c>10%</color>.
column2: Phase damage ke unit musuh yang memiliki Shield meningkat sebesar <color=#f26c1c>10%</color>.

column1: =If the Burnshield is not Short-Circuited, then at the start of this unit's turn, it and all ally units gain a shield and recover HP.
column2: Jika Burnshield tidak sedang Short-Circuited, di awal giliran unit ini, dia dan semua unit sekutu mendapatkan shield dan memulihkan HP.

column1: # --- Freeze ---

column2: Saat menyerang target yang memiliki debuff tipe Freeze, damage yang diberikan meningkat sebesar <color=#f26c1c>5%</color>.

column1: =When attacking a target with a Freeze-type debuff, damage dealt is increased by <color=#f26c1c>15%</color>.
